snippet.title: We Escaped a Twisted Game – Official Release Trailer | Co-Op Escape Game
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2524930/We_Escaped_a_Twisted_Game/

Can you escape… together?
We Escaped a Twisted Game is a two-player online co-op escape room game for PC where you and a partner must solve puzzles, communicate, and survive. Speak, trust, and work together — or risk never making it out. Perfect for fans of puzzle games, escape rooms, and co-op adventures.

Key Features:
▪ Online co-op: 2 players only
▪ Two perspectives: unique roles
▪ Built-in 3D voice chat with character voice lines
▪ Puzzle mix: guiding, frantic, clever
▪ 15 handcrafted challenges
▪ Multiple endings

Launch Date: October 24th, 2025
Wishlist on Steam to get notified at release: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2524930/We_Escaped_a_Twisted_Game/
